title: review.json
description: One review round of a pull request, as a reviewer writes it (architecture section 5). The kit validates, filters and scores it; a reviewer never scores. Unknown keys fail.

reviewer.description: Name of the agent that wrote the review.

head.description: Commit the review binds to: the pull request's head, as 40 hex digits.

findings.description: One finding per distinct issue; empty when nothing was found.

file.description: Path of the file, relative to the repository root.

line.description: Line in the file, or null when the finding has no single line.

rule.description: The project rule or standard the finding cites; empty for a general finding.

evidence.description: What proves the finding: a quoted line, a failing command, a reproduction. Required for blocking and major findings, which are discarded without it.

fix.description: The change that resolves the finding.
